name: Unwanted-call and text-message complaints to the FCC, by state and month
description: Complaints about unwanted calls, robocalls and telemarketing that people filed with the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), counted by state, month, issue and method (text message, prerecorded voice, live voice and others) from January 2015, with the last 12 months set against the 12 before and per 100,000 residents. One record per state, DC, Puerto Rico and territory for text-message complaints and one for phone-call complaints. The counts come from the FCC's open Consumer Complaints Data, grouped on the FCC's server so no complaint, caller number or free text is ever copied, and the state rows add up to a separate FCC-side count for every month. Complaints are self-reported and unverified, not findings of any violation.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Unwanted-call and text-message complaints to the FCC, by state and month (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116058

distribution.name: robocall-complaints.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: robocall-complaints.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: robocall-complaints-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in robocall-complaints-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to robocall-complaints.csv on id.

recordSet.name: robocall-complaints
recordSet.description: The records of Unwanted-call and text-message complaints to the FCC, by state and month, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: measure
field.description: text (text-message complaints) or call (phone-call complaints, including those with no method given)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: Complaints in the last 12 complete months

field.name: previous12
field.description: Complaints in the 12 months before that

field.name: referenceYear2024
field.description: Complaints in calendar year 2024, a full year with no gap in the file

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
